verdict.rationale: gstack has a few built-in automatic behaviors. Saved per-site domain skills are injected into the prompt whenever a session visits that host, and learnings are logged automatically at the end of every skill session. Voice-trigger aliases route phrases to skills, and an auto-upgrade toggle (GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE) exists. These are fixed behaviors, not a general mechanism for users to write their own event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: a user-definable rule/trigger system, configurable event sources (e.g. git, CI or file events), arbitrary action binding, documentation of authoring such rules, and independent corroboration.
